items.note: S1.3 gives the eight-row schedule on triples of [100], the three-stage result (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored, and the bank exchange over F_2, all matching Lemma lem:scalar-motifs. It does not show the net change (JV+RG)x or the cancellation by intersection coefficients (741-765), and it gives no wire counts.

S1.4 states the frames, the edge operator D_vD_u^{-1}, the commuting of a common frame with a pointwise gate, D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and the route operator eps_w D_sink D_source^{-1}, all as in 804-825. It gives the one-line reason but no separate derivation, so this is stated rather than derived.

The form I-J/9, the triple-indicator orthogonality, the result that only central 3->4 edges decrease (each by h), L=Ich, Wm-2N+2L and L_b/N=100/539 all match the paper. The complex ratio 101/539, the binary label field and the orthonormal-basis claim are missing. The derivation leaves out the actual label assignments (A,B,P,Q, the stage transitions and the gate-label table eq:motif-labels) and the residual table that make the nesting claim checkable.

S1.5.4 states the assignment of P_U and -P_{U_a}, the rank sum s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b with the N rank-one source exceptions, and the endpoint identity I_m; S1.6.2 gives the shear H<-H+D on every role. It does not give the reasons: that P_V-P_U is the identity on V cap U-perp (so its rank is the dimension change), and that P_{U_a-perp}+P_{U_a}=I_m (1158-1171).

S2.1.1 correctly states one kernel aI+bX_v (or its inverse) per orthonormal residual vector, s_c=W_cm-2N+2L_c<W_cm, and C^{tensor m} on every role after corrections. The phase frame C_U=H^{tensor m}diag(i^{q_U})H^{tensor m} is never defined, and the k-column extension is missing. The S2.1 method follows the paper's route (weight additivity mod 4, Z conjugations) but leaves out the Hadamard conversion of the character into a translation and the C^{-1} on the 27 support coordinates (1254-1310).

For the bit network the chain L/N<1/2, deficit N-2L_b>0, relative deficit >20*2^{-50}, log m<20 and s_b/W_b<m^tau with tau=1-2^{-50} follows 1331-1344 faithfully. The explicit eta values are not given, and the complex side (s_c/W_c<m^sigma, sigma=tau) is never stated or derived; S2.1.1 gives only s_c<W_cm.

Both lemmas' operations are stated, and S1.2 even names the split-at-Q-a and merge mechanism of 577-580. The condition that the offset be computable in b^{O(1)} time, and the coprimality conditions on q, are omitted from the plan's claim.

It correctly states A=E_1 Pi E_2 and the cost of exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and the three-update trick (D_j+=H_i, swap, D_j=H_i-D_j) matches 1436-1443. Missing are the elimination proof of the factorization (1375-1391), the choice of a fixed prime q avoiding all denominators, and the order of the triangular conjugations (1432-1434).

The plan follows the proof step by step: the cyclic row split into W streams of volume V/W, the shear frames Phi_M, the edges via matrix-shear, H<-H+D on every row, the three-update interchange, s calls, the O(V) fixed-tape schedule, the recurrence and the geometric sum.

S1 states the O(Vu^tau) bound for arbitrary width; S1.7 compresses the proof into one sentence (padding to [q^e], high digits as rows, base-m pieces, the cost sum). It omits the exchange-and-join of the high parts h+, d+ that forms the q^{2rho} row field (1660-1680), and it treats unequal widths not at all.

The plan has every element of 1835-1940: the conjugation by P_M to coordinate kernels, one child C^{tensor f} per basis vector, M as a fixed number of row additions, exactly s_c forward children with the inverse formula (-i)^f Z C Z, C^{tensor e} on every role, and H_0^{tensor D}=b^D S_D C^{tensor D} S_D.

It follows the proof: the eight conditional updates with their parity effect, the guard interval [10,2^{K-1}-11], the union bound giving delta_bad=min{1,80(f-1)2^{-K}}, T_0S_0^{-1} permuting B and repaired by radix sort, and the normalized extra terms o(1). The chunk-swap source of the L^tau term appears only in the motivation.

S2.3 gives the q_0 row construction and the exact 1/W child volume; S2.4 gives F(e)<=(s/W)F(e/m)+O((eK)^tau+1) with leaves at e<d^{1/2}. The conditions a=s/W<=m^sigma, K<=e^{c/beta} and max{lambda,sigma+beta(1-sigma)}<lambda' are missing, and the unrolling (internal sum O(e^lambda), leaves O(e^sigma d^{beta(1-sigma)})) is asserted, not shown.

It covers character cancellation through the y^{rj_0}=-1 shift, the DIF step, the bit-reversed storage giving B_tF_t^- and F_t^+B_t^{-1}, the layout L (O(dK) slot moves, fewer than Dq chunk exchanges), the truncation commuting with J_E, and the cost and error bounds. The reversed-procedure identification argument (2872-2887) is only asserted.
Evaluation at B_0=2^{4p}, the four products with the established multiplier, centered residues valid since |h_j|<=r2^{2p}<B_0/2, and the O(rp log(rp)) cost all match the lemma and 3233-3264.

The pipeline (two forward transforms in the retained order, pointwise products /r, the opposite transform, the exact scale by M), the normalization identity and the error total M(3delta+eta) match 3414-3473.

It follows the paper's route: TP_sF_s=P_tF_tS, the Neumann inversion of N=CTD, A=S/2 and B_0=D'J'C with normalizations multiplying to 2^{-2alpha^2}, the permutations left unsorted, and tensoring with gamma=2d alpha^2 and axis exposure in O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)). The explicit P_s,P_t formulas are not given.

Both identities are stated correctly, with a one-line reason for the cancellation (F_s^+R=R^{-1}F_s^+ and commuting with pointwise products). The chirp coefficient computation and the normalization step (3940-3980) are not developed.

The size definitions, the prime intervals, the Bernoulli bound T/2<S<T, alpha^4 theta_i>p and the n^{o(1)} search follow the paper. The definitions of eta=1/(4d), alpha and gamma, the value lambda=1-2^{-52}, and the bound gamma<=b/4 are not given.

It covers the isomorphism via the order-S image of x, the triangular digit update performed as prefix-controlled cyclic shifts in descending target order after axis reversal, padding kept zero, and the O(Tpd^2(1+l^tau)) cost.
The twist, the wrap check zeta^{k+l}(-1)^h=zeta^j, and M_C=D_- iota^{-1} M_r(iota D_+ f, iota D_+ g)=(f*g)/T match the paper. The computed twist error is not stated.

The source transform with exact counterpart 2^gamma B_0 Q F_t A=RF_s, the conjugation for RF_s^+, and the six-step pipeline with the two S scalings explained via (u*v)/S^2 match 4456-4544. The initial 2^{-b-2} input scale is only implicit in 2^{2b+4}.

E_ring<5TL, the chirp error <8TL, E_s=9*2^gamma TL, the final bound 448b2^{-3b/4}<1/2 and the carry invariant all match. The step through the pointwise product and opposite transform, E_w=S(3E_s+2)<28*2^gamma T^2L (4700-4710), and the use of gamma<=b/4 are missing between S6.3 and S6.4.

The minimum margin g_2=epsilon c(1-tau)=2^{-181}=2kappa from the layout chunk exchanges, the o(V) exceptional sorting, the absorption of log powers and the schoolbook cutoff all follow the paper. The seven normalized costs of Table tab:costs are not listed.
S0 says that no eventual Omega(n log n) lower bound holds, but it gives neither the definition of an eventual lower bound nor the liminf criterion of 381-387.

errors.says: Rows are obtained by taking rho=O(log e) high digits as a row field padded to a multiple of W^k.
errors.paper: The top rho digits of each chunk (h+, d+) are first exchanged, then joined, so the row field consists of 2rho digits of range q^{2rho}>=W^k; at the end the high parts are separated again to complete the interchange (1653-1680, 1708-1712).

chain: The tree reaches O(n(lg n)^{1-kappa}) by the paper's route. It runs from the bit network, frames, labels and rank sum, through the s<Wm saving and the interchange recurrence, then the complex phase-frame recursion and packed additions in the simultaneous layer, the synthetic transforms and convolution, resampling, chirp and CRT reductions, and on to exact recovery and the cost table. It thins out at the label construction (no label tables or residual table), at the unrolling of the layer and guard-depth recurrences, and in the error chain between E_s and the final bound, where E_w is omitted. The complex-side exponent sigma is never stated.

steps.note: It has h=100 (triples of [100]), the banks X_a,Y_a, and the fixed linear network sending (X_a,Y_a)->(-Y_a,X_a) with every scratch wire restored. N and m are not given numerically: N appears only as 'the number of data pairs', and m only through F^{tensor 3} with F=Q^100.
It states the common frame commuting with the pointwise gate, the implemented operator D_out S_Omega D_in^{-1}, and that only endpoint frames fix the route operator.

It has nondegenerate tensor-product labels in F^{tensor 3}, every edge joining comparable labels, and only the central-wire edges from time 3 to 4 decreasing, each by h=100. The explicit gate-label table is not given.
It states that each edge matrix has rank equal to its dimension change, except the N source edges, each of rank one. The reason (P_V-P_U is the identity on V cap U-perp) is not given.
It gives L=Ich and the sum Wm-2N+2L, with gate telescoping as the reason, and hence s_b=W_bm-N+2L_b.
It gives L_b/N=100/539<1/2 and the deficit N-2L_b>0, hence s_b<W_bm. The complex ratio 101/539 is not given, but the bit case carries the step.
It states that every endpoint difference is I_m and that, via the frame identity, every original row (scratch rows included) receives H<-H+D.
It has A=E_1 Pi E_2, a rank-a shear by exactly a interchanges plus O(V), and the number of recursive calls equal to the sum of edge ranks, s.
It has children of volume V/W, F_k<=(s/W)F_{k-1}+O(1), tau=1-2^{-50} from a deficit >20*2^{-50} and log m<20, and F_k=O(e^tau).

central.summary: P08 reconstructs the whole central saving in order: the fixed bank-exchanging network, frames, nested labels, rank equal to dimension change, the budget Wm-2N+2L, the strict deficit from L/N=100/539, the endpoint identity giving the shear, edges as rank-many recursive interchanges, and the recurrence with tau=1-2^{-50}. The weak points are the missing explicit N and m, the missing label tables, and the missing reason that P_V-P_U has rank equal to the dimension change.
